sections.content: You know *creo que* and *pienso que* from B1 Unit 7. Use them to explain how language can be part of identity and to give opinions about its social importance.

items.spanish: Mi lengua forma parte de mi identidad.
items.english: My language is part of my identity.

items.spanish: Creo que la lengua influye en nuestra identidad.
items.english: I think language influences our identity.

items.spanish: Pienso que cada lengua tiene su propia manera de ver el mundo.
items.english: I think each language has its own way of seeing the world.

sections.content: *Creo que* and *pienso que* state a belief, so the verb stays in the indicative: *creo que influye*. Once you negate them, *no creo que* takes the subjunctive, as you saw in B1 Unit 7.
